school_lot.name: Lot behind the elementary school
school_lot.blurb: Next to homes and the school

east_end.name: East End field
east_end.blurb: Open field on the east side

pine_south.name: Pine Street field
pine_south.blurb: South of Pine Street, near homes

campus_s.name: South of campus on College Ave

planner.name: Dana Ruiz
planner.persona: Thoughtful, data-minded borough planner who wants Millbrooke to grow without losing its character. Likes walkable design. Will trade features to save money but protects the memorial.

merchants.name: Walt Kessler
merchants.persona: Folksy hardware-store owner speaking for downtown merchants. Beloved in town, big-hearted, a little vague on numbers. Wants lots of stores and enough parking so customers come back.

keystone.name: Brent Hollis
keystone.persona: Polished regional developer. Competent and fast, but protects his margins. Resists anything that cuts leasable space or parking unless the borough gives something back.

engineer.name: Sam Yoder
engineer.persona: Plainspoken engineer. Gives straight answers about risk and cost.

brand.name: Celeste Varga
brand.persona: Smooth corporate site-selection director for a national luxury handbag brand. Wants a big incentive and short commitments. Very wary of clawback clauses.

bowers_operator.name: Ruth Bowers
bowers_operator.persona: Explain a day of deliveries and field work; distinguish operation from title.

freight_operator.name: Alex Moreno
freight_operator.persona: Discuss loading and storage, without promising permits or council votes.

college_liaison.name: Dr. Leena Shah
college_liaison.persona: Ask concrete questions about loading and customers. A concern is not a veto.

council.name: Greg Marsh
council.blurb: Wants your job. Pro-growth, low taxes, loves a ribbon cutting.

council.name: Ellen Pryor
council.blurb: Retired accountant. Guards the reserve fund.

pri.prop: long-term property values and tax base

council.name: Rev. James Okafor
council.blurb: Pastor at First Methodist. Neighborhoods first.

council.name: Tina Brandt
council.blurb: Owns the Main Street diner. Watches foot traffic.

council.name: Hal Weaver
council.blurb: Dairy farmer. Protects farmland, hates waste.

bridge.title: Main Street bridge repair
bridge.blurb: The 1958 bridge over Kish Creek failed its last inspection. It carries every car into downtown.

stripmall.title: Route 22 Shopping Plaza
stripmall.blurb: A strip mall on farmland at Route 22. Fast to build, cheap stores, lots of parking.

park.title: Old Mill Memorial Park
park.blurb: Turn the vacant Old Mill lot into a veterans memorial park on the creek.

commerce.title: Old Mill Commons
commerce.blurb: Merchants want new storefronts on the Old Mill lot. Stores downtown are always full.

boutique.title: Halden & Pierce flagship
boutique.blurb: A luxury handbag brand wants the vacant Main Street storefront, with a tax incentive.

studenthousing.title: College Ave Student Lofts
studenthousing.blurb: Penns Valley College is growing. Keystone wants to build student apartments south of campus.

subdivision.title: Ridge Road Estates
subdivision.blurb: Subdivide the old Bowers dairy on Ridge Road into single-family homes.
